name: Smart Translate
description: Detects the source language automatically and translates text on the device using ML Kit's on-demand offline language models. Voice input and Persian read-aloud use Link speech and text-to-speech plugins.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.attribution: Google ML Kit Translation and Language Identification APIs

release_notes: Uses the Translator API's built-in on-demand model download path; removes the separate RemoteModelManager download call.
